blazers.pulse: Portland bounced back Monday with a 128-111 win in Philadelphia, handing the Sixers only their fourth loss behind 31 points from Deni Avdija. That puts the Blazers at 11-6, and they host the Spurs tonight in an NBA Cup game, still without Ja Morant.
storylines: Avdija hit five 3s for 31 points and 7 assists in the Philly win
Donovan Clingan posted 15 and 18; Jrue Holiday and Scoot Henderson gave 35 off the bench
Ja Morant (left hamstring strain) is out again tonight; Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci also out
Tonight vs. Spurs at home, 7 PM PT; Wembanyama and Fox both questionable

timbers.pulse: FC Dallas won Game 1 of the first-round series 3-0 in Frisco on Saturday, so Portland has to win at home to stay alive. Game 2 is Saturday night at Providence Park.
storylines: Game 1: Joaquin Valiente scored twice in three minutes and Sam Sarver added one in stoppage time
Game 2: Sat Nov 28, 7:30 PM PT at Providence Park (Apple TV, FS1)
If Portland wins, Game 3 is at Dallas on Wed Dec 2, time TBD

f1.pulse: Max Verstappen won a wild Las Vegas GP by 0.639s over Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri, in a race with more than 30 lead changes. The title is already settled, since Kimi Antonelli clinched it in Mexico City, so Qatar this weekend is about wins and bragging rights.
storylines: Verstappen's fourth win of the season
Ferrari's Hamilton and Leclerc collided with each other again
Antonelli finished fourth after late car trouble let the McLarens by
Antonelli, 20, is F1's youngest-ever champion
Next up: Qatar, the penultimate round, Nov 27 to 29

ducks.pulse: Oregon rolled Michigan State 45-7 last Friday and sits at No. 13, 8-3 (6-2 Big Ten). Now it's Husky week, and a win over Washington plus a little help elsewhere would send the Ducks to the Big Ten title game.
storylines: Next game: Sat Nov 28, 4:30 PM PT vs. Washington at Autzen, on NBC
Freshman Brandon Smith ran for 121 yards and 2 TDs at Michigan State
Title-game path: beat UW plus an Iowa loss, a UCLA win or an Indiana win (ESPN Research)
Oregon is a 14-point favorite (DraftKings)

niners.pulse: The 49ers crushed the Vikings 35-10 in Mexico City on Sunday night to go 9-1, and Brock Purdy heard MVP chants. Next up is a home rivalry game with Seattle on Sunday afternoon.
storylines: Next game: Sun Nov 29, 1:25 PM PT vs. Seahawks at Levi's Stadium, on FOX
Purdy went 21 of 26 for 255 yards and 3 TDs
George Kittle caught two touchdowns
9-1 is the seventh time in franchise history the 49ers have started that well or better
